summary: Frontend e2e tested via Playwright against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Auth gating, onboarding 3-step, Today, Calendar (incl. 31 day rows + side Sheet), Rule of Life (7 pillars, add+delete), Prayer Tracker matrix, Challenges (5 templates, start, member checkin, active list), Household add member, Settings (theme toggle + save), and Logout all pass. No critical UI defects found.

issues: A11y warning: Radix DialogContent missing `Description` or `aria-describedby`. Cosmetic, but should be addressed by adding <SheetDescription> for screen readers.

action_items: (Optional) Add SheetDescription / aria-describedby to Calendar day Sheet to silence Radix a11y warnings.
(Cosmetic) None blocking; previous backend optional items still apply.
critical_code_review_comments: AppShell nav uses derived testid `nav-${label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'-')}-link`; for 'Rule of Life' this becomes `nav-rule-of-life-link` and for 'Prayer' it is `nav-prayer-link` (NOT `nav-prayer-tracker-link`). Document this convention or hardcode stable testids to avoid future test churn.

Onboarding parent-color testid embeds raw hex strings (e.g. `onboarding-parent-color-#7d3c5b-button`); the `#` is fine in attribute value but is awkward for selectors. Consider using semantic names (purple/green/gold).
AuthProvider correctly skips /me when URL hash contains session_id; AuthCallback uses useRef hasProcessed — no re-exchange race observed.
Calendar fetches /liturgical/calendar each month — works; consider caching to avoid re-fetch on month nav.
test_credentials: Mongo-seeded ephemeral session test_session_1778094326978 (cleaned up after run).
seed_data_creation: Inserted one user + session in test_database, ran the full onboarding -> household creation flow, then cleaned up household, members, rules, rule_checkins, prayer_logs, challenges, challenge_checkins, user, and user_session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend critical paths verified end-to-end. Nav testids: nav-today-link, nav-calendar-link, nav-rule-of-life-link, nav-prayer-link, nav-challenges-link, nav-household-link. Settings link uses settings-link. Calendar requires a brief wait (~1.5s) after navigation for /liturgical/calendar fetch before day rows appear. To re-seed: `mongosh --quiet --eval 'use("test_database"); ...'` per /app/auth_testing.md and add cookie domain emergent-blueprint-2.preview.emergentagent.com.
rca of the issue: No bugs reproduced. Two minor non-blocking issues observed: (1) Radix Sheet missing description (a11y warning only); (2) the testid pattern derived from labels is brittle but currently consistent.
